title: fuzzlab lab-generator manifest (Phase 0 foundation)
description: Per CR-LAB-0001 §3/§6 and D20: `transform` is an ordered pipeline of ops (never a single enum), and `sink_context` is a structured object (a family plus the set of neutralizations a transform must satisfy to be SECURE for that family) rather than a bare string. The verdict itself is never asserted here — it is derived by fuzzlab.labgen.verdict.verdict() from a cell's (transform, sink_context) against a versioned safety matrix. Phase 0's manifest lists cells explicitly (one axis level each). Phase 1 (T-LAB2.1) adds `axis_ranges`, alongside (not replacing) explicit `cells`: each block is expanded by fuzzlab.labgen.resolver's covertable-backed covering-array engine into concrete cells before fuzzlab.labgen.schema's loader ever builds the Cell IR.

manifest_version.description: Version of this manifest schema/shape. Independent of safety_matrix_version so an old manifest keeps meaning what it meant (CR-LAB-0001 §5 risk mitigation).

safety_matrix_version.description: Which safety-matrix version this manifest's cells must be derived against. A verdict() caller pins this so old corpora stay re-derivable under old rules if the matrix changes later.

axis_ranges.description: Covering-array axis-range blocks (T-LAB2.1). Each block expands, via fuzzlab.labgen.resolver.expand(), into concrete cells that are appended after any explicit `cells` (same Cell IR, same dupe-checked cell_id namespace). Absent or empty: manifest loading is byte-for-byte identical to the explicit-cells-only format.

family.description: The structural context the tainted value reaches, e.g. sql_string_literal, sql_numeric_literal, html_body, html_attribute_quoted, html_attribute_unquoted. Never a vulnerability-class name (that lives in the cell's `class` field, which is generator-input only and is never emitted into served artifacts).

required_neutralizations.description: Concern IDs (e.g. sql_syntax_break, html_tag_break) that a pipeline must fully neutralize for this sink_context to be SECURE.

pipeline.description: Ordered transform ops applied to the tainted value before it reaches the sink (CR-LAB-0001 §3: transform is a pipeline, not a single enum). Empty array = raw/unmediated value (the baseline vulnerable case).

cell_id.description: Stable identifier for this cell within the manifest. Generator-internal; the emitted/served artifact's own IDs (labels.json case_id, etc.) stay the opaque contract FR-LAB-2 already requires — this schema does not weaken that.

class.description: Vulnerability class this cell demonstrates (generator-input only, e.g. for the safety matrix / pattern-corpus bookkeeping and for gates like the fingerprint-independence checks in later phases). Never leaked into a served URL/filename/parameter name — enforced by the name-leak scanner build gate (NFR-LAB-no-leak), which runs against the *generated* artifact tree, not this manifest.

stack_profile.description: Which stack/emitter this cell targets, e.g. php_current (Phase 0's only emitter).

nuisance.description: Opaque bag of nuisance-axis values (naming, whitespace, comment style, etc.) that must not affect the derived verdict. Reserved for the covering-array/nuisance-independence work in later phases; unused by Phase 0's verdict derivation.

axis_range.description: One covering-array request. `factors` maps a fixed set of recognized axis names to their level lists and is passed straight through to fuzzlab.labgen.resolver.expand() (its 'factors' key) alongside strength/sub_models/constraints, so this shape matches what the resolver already accepts rather than inventing a new one. Any Cell field not varied by an axis here must be supplied as this block's own fixed value (class/stack_profile/route/transform/sink_context), or expansion fails closed with a clear error -- never a silently-defaulted field.

cell_id_prefix.description: Prefix for generated cell_ids: '<prefix><4-digit 1-based index>' (e.g. 'LABGEN-CA-0001'), in the resolver's own row order (deterministic — see resolver.expand()'s pinned-sorter guarantee).

strength.description: Covering-array strength t. Default 2 (pairwise), per CR-LAB-0001's default and fuzzlab.labgen.resolver's own default.

sub_models.description: Forwarded verbatim to resolver.expand()'s 'sub_models' -- a stronger covering requirement over a subset of these factors.

constraints.description: Forwarded verbatim to resolver.expand()'s 'constraints' -- declarative row exclusions.

factors.description: Axis name -> level list. Only these axis names are recognized (each maps to a Cell field the loader knows how to place); an unrecognized key is a schema error rather than being silently passed through and ignored (PA-0010).

sink_context_family.description: Varies sink_context.family. Requires this block's `sink_context_neutralizations` to map every level here to its required_neutralizations list.

class.description: Fixed value used when 'class' is not a factor.

stack_profile.description: Fixed value used when 'stack_profile' is not a factor.

route.description: Fixed value used for any of method/path not covered by the route_method/route_path factors.

transform.description: Fixed value used when 'transform' is not a factor.

sink_context.description: Fixed value used when 'sink_context_family' is not a factor.

sink_context_neutralizations.description: Required, and must have an entry for every 'sink_context_family' factor level, when that axis is present: maps each family value to the required_neutralizations list the generated sink_context carries for that family (this is a function of family, not an independent covering-array axis).
